title: 국가를 당사자로 하는 소송의 수행자에 대한 포상금 지급 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:1:0:00001:part:1/1
title_original: 국가를 당사자로 하는 소송의 수행자에 대한 포상금 지급 규칙
full_text: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of these Rules is to prescribe matters necessary for paying monetary rewards to litigation performers who are public officials belonging to the Ministry of Justice or other administrative agencies and who have obtained judgments favorable to the State or an administrative agency in litigation to which the State or the administrative agency is a party.
